title: LionByteGG Bot — Flagship PNW Esports Discord Bot

overview.purpose: Main/flagship Discord bot for PNW Esports. Handles member onboarding (Student/Guest), moderation with 3-tier AutoMod sync, ticket support, varsity/JV team registration + Discord role sync, dynamic voice channel generation, arena status presence, GGLeap PC-status/game-list panels, and a watchlist surveillance feature.
overview.stack: discord.py >= 2.3.0, SQLite (user_records.db), JSON files, cryptography (Fernet for PII)

entry_points.run_combined.py: Runs BOTH the bot and the Flask web dashboard in one process (dashboard on a background thread, bot on the main async loop)
entry_points.intro_animation.py: Matrix-style ASCII startup animation shown before the bot launches
entry_points.master_terminal.py: PyQt6 GUI control panel to start/stop/monitor ALL 6 services at once

env_vars.SECURITY_CODE: Optional override, default 146332 — required by several destructive admin commands via a modal
env_vars.GGLEAP_AUTH_TOKEN_GAMES: GGLeap API token for the games/apps list feature
env_vars.GGLEAP_AUTH_TOKEN_STATUS: GGLeap API token for the PC status feature

on_ready: Instantiate 3 cogs directly (not via extension): AdminCommands, TicketCommands, Moderation
Start loops: dashboard_sync_loop(30s), check_for_timeouts(1m), arena_status_loop(1m), process_moderation_queue(10s), check_bot_control(5s), process_discord_notifications(10s)

data_files.data/bot_status.json: Bot latency, guild count, member count — read by Nova web dashboard
data_files.data/join_times.json: Tracks when a user joined (for the 4-day incomplete-setup kick)
data_files.data/moderation_queue.json: Moderation actions queued by the dashboard for the bot to execute
data_files.data/bot_control.json: Dashboard 'restart'/'stop' commands (must be < 30s old to be honored)
data_files.data/discord_notification_queue.json: General-purpose queue: varsity registrations, team announcements, ticket actions, VC control actions
data_files.data/job_progress.json: Long-running job progress (e.g. bulk Discord role sync)
data_files.data/teams.json / data/rosters.json: Varsity team + player roster data (rosters.json PII Fernet-encrypted)
data_files.data/esports_games.json: Playable games list used by varsity registration forms
data_files.data/arena_hours.json: Weekly open/close hours consumed by arena_status.py
data_files.user_records.db (SQLite): user_records table: id, user_id, type, reason, moderator, moderator_id, source, timestamp — indexed on user_id

on_member_join: Sends welcome embed with Student/Guest Access buttons (SetupView) to SETUP_CHANNEL_ID
on_member_remove: Removes welcome message if user left before setup
on_message: Watchlist message tracking (normal=log only, high=immediate alert)
on_voice_state_update: vc-system.py: generator-VC join creates a temp VC; generated-VC leave deletes it if empty

background_tasks.name: check_for_timeouts
background_tasks.does: DMs a reminder if a pending_users entry is > 1 minute old

background_tasks.name: arena_status_loop
background_tasks.does: Calls update_arena_status(bot) to refresh bot presence

background_tasks.name: dashboard_sync_loop
background_tasks.does: save_bot_status(), save_members_cache(), applies pending bot_activity.json changes

background_tasks.name: process_moderation_queue
background_tasks.does: Applies queued moderation actions (warn/kick/ban) from moderation_queue.json

background_tasks.name: process_discord_notifications
background_tasks.does: Main dashboard->bot bridge; see notification_types below

background_tasks.name: registration_timeout_check
background_tasks.does: Kicks users who joined > 4 days ago and never completed Student/Guest setup

commands.name: /force-setup-user
commands.does: DMs the onboarding SetupView to a specific user

commands.name: /club
commands.does: Link to Student Life club signup

commands.name: /announce
commands.does: Gold announcement embed, pings Student role

commands.name: /setup_guest_transfer
commands.does: Posts a permanent 'Migrate to Student' button (MigrateToStudentView)

commands.name: /force-register-all
commands.does: Two-stage confirmation (threshold 50 users), DMs SetupView to all non-student/non-bot members, 2s rate limit per DM

modal.SecurityCodeModal: Prompts for the SECURITY_CODE env var before proceeding with a sensitive action

cogs.flagged_words_file: data/flagged_words.json — 3-tier system: bannable (auto-ban), kickable (auto-kick), warning (DM only)
cogs.event_on_automod_action: Deduplicates by user_id:rule_id:message_id; checks custom tiers first (ban/kick/DM as appropriate), else logs 'AutoMod Flag' (Discord already blocked it); always logs to DB + AutoMod log channel
cogs.event_on_audit_log_entry_create: Monitors ban/kick audit entries, logs to #lionbyte-logs

commands.name: /addword
commands.does: Adds word + triggers Discord AutoMod sync

key_methods: add_record(user_id, type_, reason, moderator, moderator_id, source)

events: on_raw_reaction_add (adds role, DMs confirmation, retries on 429 up to 5x)

command.name: /userinfo
command.does: Full profile: identity, moderation record summary, guest timer, varsity registration status, last 50 record transcript

cogs.modal: ActionReasonModal (used by Clear Record, Kick, Ban buttons)
views: ClearRecordView (Clear Record, Cancel Timer, Reset Guest Timer, Kick, Ban, Register Varsity, VarsityHUB — 60s timeout)

cogs.event_on_voice_state_update: Joining a generator VC creates '{Generator Name} #{N}' and moves the member in; leaving a generated VC deletes it once empty

utils/db.py.table: user_records (id PK, user_id, type, reason, moderator, moderator_id, source default 'discord', timestamp) + idx_user_id

utils.utils/safe_json.py: Thread-safe JSON I/O with shared RLock; auto-.bak backup + recovery for critical files (rosters.json, teams.json, watchlist.json, ticket_log.json, player_reports.json); atomic write via temp+rename; retries up to 5x on Windows PermissionError

utils/arena_status.py.function: update_arena_status(bot) — sets presence to 'Arena Open • Closes at HH:MM' / 'Arena Closed • Opens at HH:MM' / 'Arena Closed • Opens {day}'; respects admin custom-activity override

utils/automod_sync.py.purpose: Syncs the 3-tier flagged word lists to Discord's native AutoMod via REST API v10

utils/ggleap_games.py.purpose: Polls GGLeap /apps/get-enabled-apps-summary, posts an interactive game/app list panel
utils/ggleap_games.py.view: RequestGameButtonView ('➕ Request a Game' -> link to request form)

utils/ggleap_status.py.purpose: Polls GGLeap /machines/get-all for arena PC status, posts a status panel

views/setup_view.py.AccountSetupModal_result: Sets nickname '{first_name} ({ign})', removes Guest role, adds Student role, sends confirmation + club signup link, logs to lionbyte-logs
views/setup_view.py.GuestAccessModal_result: Adds Guest role, starts a 30-day timer via set_guest_timer()
views/setup_view.py.background_helper: remove_expired_guests(bot) — DMs + kicks users whose guest_times/*.json has expired

support_types: Arena PCs (Technician Support, pings technician role)

flow: PlayerTypeSelectView (Varsity/JV/Sub Varsity/Sub JV) -> VarsityRegistrationView (game -> details -> personal info -> confirm)
PersistentVarsityRegistrationView ('Start Registration', survives restarts via fixed custom_id)

batch_files.Start LionServices.bat: Master launcher: single-instance guard (checks port 5000), runs intro_animation.py, launches all 6 services minimized in order, opens Master Terminal last
batch_files.start_bot.bat: Green ASCII banner, cd to script dir, 'python main.py', pause on exit
batch_files.stop_bot.bat: Kills window titled 'LionByteGG Bot*' + reads data/bot.pid to kill that PID + greps python processes running main.py

deployment_checklist: Create roles: Student, Guest, Technician, Varsity, JV
Create channels: #setup, #ticket-panel (auto log channels are self-created)
Set GUILD_ID + all role/channel IDs in utils/constants.py
Verify: new member joins -> sees Student/Guest setup message
